ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is amended by changing all of the M2-2,
Light Industry District, C2-3, Motor Vehicle Related Commercial District, and C1-2,
Neighborhood Commercial District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 6-F in
the area bound by:

the alley next north of and parallel West 24" Street; South Canal Street; West 24" Place;
and the alley next west of and paralle! South Canal Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
